transcript.text: I'd like to add my perspective as Internal Communications on how we can implement this. Priyanka's three recommendations align well with the commitment I made to remote staff. The written nomination board approach I promised would serve as the asynchronous recognition route for non-attendees, and since nominations are submitted privately in writing, it ensures participation is genuinely opt-in with no pressure to speak. From a communications standpoint, I'd want to make sure the event announcements clearly frame both the live event and the written board as voluntary options, so remote staff in particular understand they can participate through either channel without feeling put on the spot.
